status: Manage ERPX now has an owner-local native company-onboarding view, HTTP ingress and a fail-closed Next transport/SSR cutover. Shared composition mounting and the onboarding command remain open; no catalogue workflow or browser verification is claimed.

scope.catalogueRelationship: Company onboarding is the pre-Holding lifecycle path used before a customer Company appears in manage_erpx/overview. This is a foundation slice, not completion of manage_erpx/overview, billing, iam or executive.
scope.domain: Strict verified-Account onboarding facts: owner slot slug/company/branch/state, allowed available/provisioning/active states, bounded names and an explicit unverified denial. No Holding, Company, assignment or permission is minted.
scope.application: One owner read use case that requires verified email, reads only the current Account's reserved beta_slots row and returns the public-registration flag with the owner slot.
scope.adapters: Owner SQL over Manage ERPX control-plane beta_slots. The caller must provide a retained SERIALIZABLE transaction; missing transaction and read-committed callers fail closed. A malformed persisted slot is an unavailable source failure, never an invented default.
scope.http: Owner-local Router for GET /api/v1/onboarding with exact registered Host selection, duplicate-Host rejection, business-error status mapping and private/no-store/no-referrer/nosniff responses. The backend receives headers and returns data plus a userId context; the router mints no session or authority.
scope.transport: Server-only Next transport validates ERPX_NATIVE_MANAGE_ERPX_CONFIG (loopback private base, reserved-port denial, exact registered front origins, timeout), forwards the actual Host and Account cookie, validates the exact response shape and context identity, bounds response bytes and maps failures. Unset or invalid configuration never falls back to the legacy TypeScript read.
scope.ssr: The onboarding page reads through the native transport for verified Accounts and renders a temporary-unavailable state when configuration is absent or the native read fails. Unverified Accounts keep the verification-required message and perform no owner read.
scope.rest: GET /api/v1/onboarding now serves the native view and returns 503 NATIVE_MANAGE_ERPX_UNAVAILABLE without native configuration. POST /api/v1/onboarding remains the retained TypeScript onboarding command.
scope.notClaimed: No browser journey, authenticated page render, shared composition mount, onboarding command, beta team mutation, public-origin policy, release/config read, Platform overview, billing, IAM or executive workflow is claimed.
